an5.134:1.1: pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato rājā khattiyo muddhābhisitto yassaṃ yassaṃ disāyaṃ viharati sakasmiṃyeva vijite viharati
an5.134:2.2: idha bhikkhave rājā khattiyo muddhābhisitto ubhato sujāto hoti mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā akkhitto anupakuṭṭho jātivādena
an5.134:2.4: balavā kho pana hoti caturaṅginiyā senāya samannāgato assavāya ovādapaṭikārāya
an5.134:2.5: parināyako kho panassa hoti paṇḍito byatto medhāvī paṭibalo atītānāgatapaccuppanne atthe cintetuṃ
an5.134:2.7: so iminā yasapañcamena dhammena samannāgato yassaṃ yassaṃ disāyaṃ viharati sakasmiṃyeva vijite viharati
an5.134:3.1: evameva kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu yassaṃ yassaṃ disāyaṃ viharati vimuttacittova viharati
an5.134:3.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlavā hoti …pe… sikkhati sikkhāpadesu
an5.134:3.6: rājāva khattiyo muddhābhisitto aḍḍho mahaddhano mahābhogo paripuṇṇakosakoṭṭhāgāro
an5.134:3.7: āraddhaviriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu
an5.134:3.9: paññavā hoti udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā
an5.134:3.12: so iminā vimuttipañcamena dhammena samannāgato yassaṃ yassaṃ disāyaṃ viharati vimuttacittova viharati
